questions.q: What event first changed the belief that all swans were white?
a: Discovery of black swans in Australia
questions.why: Dutch explorers saw black swans in 1697.

questions.q: What fallacy involves treating real-world risk like a game?
questions.why: Taleb calls it the ludic fallacy.

questions.q: Why do people often mispredict future events using past data?
a: They assume the future will repeat the past
questions.why: Using past as explanation leads to wrong predictions.

questions.q: Which example illustrates the ludic fallacy in insurance decisions?
a: Adding disease probabilities to decide coverage
questions.why: Adding probabilities for diseases is a ludic fallacy.

questions.q: What is a key characteristic of a Black Swan event?
questions.why: It is unpredictable because our outlook is too narrow.
